title: Protocol
description: The wire's entry points; each field puts one type under `definitions`.

Frame.description: One line from the app: the id to reply to, and the command.

oneOf.description:
The `SessionOptions` the wire exposes, as top-level fields of `open`
and `generate`.

The `SessionOptions` the wire exposes, as top-level fields of `open`
and `generate`.

AgentRef.description: A catalog id like `"claude"`, or an ACP agent the catalog does not know.

PermissionMode.description: How anyagent handles tool permission requests.

oneOf.description: Forward each request to the application.
Allow each permission request once without forwarding it.

McpServer.description: A client-owned MCP server the agent should connect to, forwarded at open.

oneOf.description: One entry per question, in order.

RollbackScope.description:
What `rollback` rewinds: conversation context only, or also the files
the agent changed in the dropped turns (requires `RollbackFiles`).

Line.description: One line to the app. Untagged, so each variant is a flat object.

Hello.description: The first line: which protocol, from which crate version.

Event.description: One normalized event produced by anyagent.

sequence.description: Starts at 1 and increases for every session event.

occurred_at.description:
When the engine produced this event — wall-clock, so transcripts can
be stored and merged without the app stamping receive time. Order
across events is guaranteed by `sequence`, not by this clock. A
transcript stored before this field existed reads as the epoch.

turn_info.description: Present when the event belongs to a turn.

extensions.description: Provider-specific data that has not been normalized.

parent_tool_id.description: Present for events produced by a subagent spawned from this tool call.

oneOf.description:
Provider-originated user-role content, e.g. a parent agent steering
a subagent. Never a replay of the caller's own prompt.
No more deltas will arrive for this message.
Cumulative snapshot of one tool call: start, each change, completion.
Streamed output of a running command tool.
The agent's full current task list; replaces the previous one.

The session's UI state flipped: working, needing input, or idle.
Emitted only on change; `session.status()` answers without the stream.
Context-window occupancy for this session.
The agent compacted its context; the next `ContextUsage` drops.
Plan quota for the account, pushed by the adapter.

ToolUpdate.description: Cumulative snapshot of one tool call.

raw.description: Agent's own tool name and raw input, for unknown or MCP tools.

oneOf.description: Spawned a subagent; nested events carry this id in `parent_tool_id`.

Request.description:
Something the agent is waiting on the caller for. Answer once with
`Session::answer`.

tool.description: The tool call awaiting approval, as the app already saw it.

options.description: What the agent offers; answers outside this list are rejected.

SessionInfo.description: Snapshot of a live session. Also carried by `EventKind::SessionUpdated`.

title.description: Agent-suggested title when the wire provides one.

status.description: Current UI state; kept fresh by the engine.

AgentInstallation.description: One installed agent, as returned by `Runtime::discover`.

upgrade.description:
A richer runtime for this agent that is not installed (Antigravity's
ACP server). `open` works without it with fewer capabilities; the
record says what to install to get the rest.

AgentDetails.description: What `probe` and `open` learn about an agent.

AuthStatus.description: Whether, and how, an agent is logged in.

AuthKind.description: The login kind decides which features exist (plan usage needs a subscription).

LoginMethod.description: A login method the application can show to the user.

oneOf.description: Run this full argv in a terminal the user can see.
Set this environment variable before `open`.

Capabilities.description: Effective caller actions for one agent or session.

Capability.description: Optional actions supported by an agent or session.

oneOf.description: `rollback` may also restore the files the dropped turns changed.
`compact` can summarize the session's context on demand.

ConfigOption.description:
A session setting the agent advertises. Well-known ids: `model`, `effort`,
`mode`, `sandbox`, `fast` (boolean, lower latency with increased usage).

live.description: Changeable through `Session::configure`; the adapter may resume internally.

SessionStatus.description:
What a UI should show for the session right now. Changes arrive as
`EventKind::StatusChanged`; `Session::status` reads it without the stream.

oneOf.description: No turn running and nothing queued.
A turn is running.
The agent is blocked on an answer to at least one open request.

PlanUsage.description: Plan quota windows for the logged-in account.

plan.description: The plan the quota belongs to ("max", "edu"), when the agent names it.

oneOf.description: The provider protocol explicitly ended the turn.
Anyagent inferred completion after the provider went quiet.

ErrorBody.description: The `error` object: `kind`, `message`, and the variant's own fields.

DiscoveryReport.description: What `discover` found and what it could not read.

missing.description:
Known agents that were not found, with where we looked and how to
install them.

Delivery.description: Immediate result of submitting a prompt.

prompt_id.description: Stable across immediate delivery and later queue promotion.

position.description: Number of prompts ahead of this one.
